title: Global security policies
description: Manage allowed CORS browser origins and outbound hosts for external API calls.

inherited.title: Server-inherited entries
inherited.description: These entries come from environment variables and can only be changed at server deploy time.
inherited.empty: There are no inherited server entries.

cors.title: Allowed CORS origins
cors.description: Use exact browser origins in scheme://host[:port] format.

hosts.title: Allowed external API hosts
hosts.description: Use exact hostnames only, without scheme or port.

notes.title: How it applies
notes.description: The effective value is the union of server-inherited configuration and app-managed entries.

warning.title: You may lose access from this browser
warning.description: The current origin {{origin}} will no longer be allowed by CORS after saving.

messages.saveError: Security policy could not be updated
